lessons: A check declaration whose inputs include the docs tree also covers cycles/, so each cycle mutation invalidates its own evidence. Exclude the cycle directory with exclude_inputs; the runner supports it, but the cycle skill's testing reference does not document it.
plan revisions are refused outside the Plan phase; a scope addition found during Build is recorded with task-add and its reason.
In Claude Code the crux:developer subagent ran in an isolated git worktree, so the coordinator must apply its diff to the main checkout before Test.

The reviewer role cannot verify evidence fingerprints itself; the coordinator re-validated the reused evidence after review.
reflection.outcome: Delivered in one pass. The distributed template §10 now routes cycle phrases to the cycle skill and describes dev-cycle, iterate, patch-cycle, fix-directly, author-promptbook and run-promptbook as compatibility or historical routes. A markers-only parity clause gates the cycle row. Two USER_GUIDE parity clauses left stale by the 4.0 heading rename were re-anchored, so the parity test module passes on main again. Independent review approved. This cycle also served as an end-to-end check of the cycle workflow under Claude Code with the installed 4.0.0 plugin: the writer, shared test evidence, crux:developer and crux:reviewer delegation, the visualizer, and the crux-mods /crux-dashboard all worked.
